title: Proposed evidence-backed technical checks (NOT executable KiCad DRC rules)
notes: No numeric threshold should be inferred from missing value: null is unknown.
The PASS condition text is a contract for future agent, not evidence a specific PCB passes.
Sources TSnn and reference RDnn are defined in TECHNICAL_SOURCES.md and REFERENCE_DESIGN_CATALOG.md.
High-level electrical/EMI checks cannot be substituted by generic DRC.

checks.title: Copper zone net must match intended ground net
checks.pass_condition: Zone assigned to intended GND net, copper refilled, DRC and connectivity rechecked
checks.failure_condition: zone is unassigned or assigned to different net, or unresolved islands where return required

checks.title: High-speed reference GND plane continuity
checks.applies_if: Critical fast-edge trace has adjacent reference copper
checks.pass_condition: No unmitigated plane split/void across critical route; return path documented at reference transitions
checks.failure_condition: trace crosses a split with unsupported return-path detour

checks.title: Switching converter hot-loop placement
checks.pass_condition: High-di/dt current loop is minimized relative to feasible candidates with vendor-based grounding and CIN
checks.failure_condition: Long loop due to placement mismatch or avoidable return detour
checks.automation: Needs schematic graph + geometric candidate comparison

checks.title: Feedback node shielded from switching SW
checks.applies_if: Buck regulator has high impedance FB/COMP network
checks.pass_condition: FB/sense routing avoids noisy switch/inductor region per vendor
checks.failure_condition: FB long parallel path alongside SW or under inductive switching loop without mitigation
checks.automation: Spatial net-class checks; manual risk assessment

checks.title: USB pair routing follows actual PHY requirements
checks.applies_if: USB data pair confirmed and protocol mode known
inputs: pair length gap width skew vias
checks.pass_condition: Pair-specific impedance/spacing/skew and return path satisfy chosen PHY + fab
checks.failure_condition: Uses unsupported generic 90Ω or 50Ω targets without layer-specific impedance verification

checks.title: Exposed pad / via-in-pad manufacturing check
checks.applies_if: QFN/LGA/BGA thermal or GND exposed pad
checks.pass_condition: Exposed pad electrically and thermally linked and solderable with vetted via/paste structure
checks.failure_condition: Unsupported via-in-pad/solder wicking or incorrect land pattern

checks.title: High-current track width verified by ΔT and voltage drop
checks.applies_if: Expected load current specified on power net
checks.pass_condition: Thermal and resistive drop analysis meets project targets
checks.failure_condition: Trace or neckdown cannot carry current or causes excessive voltage drop/temp rise

checks.title: SMT component spacing must satisfy assembly tolerance
checks.applies_if: Surface-mount components and fab rules present
checks.pass_condition: Clearance, placement and soldermask geometry supported by actual assembler
checks.failure_condition: courtyard overlaps, mask slivers, inaccessible rework where prohibited

checks.title: ADC input/reference and clock mutual isolation
checks.applies_if: Sensitive mixed-signal analog frontend or high-speed ADC
checks.pass_condition: Functional partition and return currents minimize aggressor/victim coupling as required by SNR/ENOB
checks.failure_condition: Noisy digital/clock segment routed over sensitive reference without mitigation
checks.automation: Partial grouping and proximity check; performance requires measurement/simulation

checks.title: DRC artifacts current and manual edits preserved
checks.applies_if: Review or PCB release after source change
checks.pass_condition: No unresolved hard violations, refreshed zones, review report tied to current revision, manual edits protected
checks.failure_condition: DRC old/stale, zones not refilled, manual modifications overwritten, no source provenance
checks.automation: KIcad CLI DRC and revision-diff; independent review still required
